findings.problem: Thirteen current extraction rows extend 天福中 conversions through AD 944, but Later Jin Tianfu in this chapter is independently capped at AD 942; Kaiyun begins after that cap.
findings.action: Apply the sealed AD 936–942 Tianfu intervals (or explicit undated treatment where appropriate) before any audited approval on the current extraction hash.

findings.problem: Current extraction reattaches dynasty- or reign-wide Western intervals to kinship, genealogy, and retrospective ruler mentions that the audited historical packet left explicitly undated.
findings.action: Remove borrowed dynasty intervals and retain source-only undated attestations on the listed rows.

findings.problem: Current extraction widens or weakens several phase-specific Chinese labels (末帝嗣位/登極, 天成末, 莊宗入汴, 高祖即位之二年, 天福七年至八年) relative to the narrower audited geometry.
findings.action: Restore single-event, late-era, or explicit interval conversions matching each cited Chinese phrase before re-audit.
